about.title: How JAMCO got its start.
text: JAMCO Insurance opened its doors in 2001 with a simple mission: make insurance personal again. Back then, we saw too many families and business owners stuck with one-size-fits-all policies from agents who did not take the time to listen. We knew there had to be a better way, so we built an agency that puts people first, where every client gets real guidance rather than a sales pitch.

Over the past 24 years, we have grown from a single office in Pasadena to serving communities across Greater Houston. Today, we work with 38 trusted carriers to bring our clients more choices and better rates. Our bilingual team is proud to serve Texas families in both English and Spanish. What has not changed is the reason we started: helping our neighbors protect what matters most.

values.title: Independence
values.text: Since we are not limited to a single carrier, we explore the market and advocate for the best coverage options at the most competitive prices for you.

values.title: Guidance
values.text: Insurance can be confusing. We are here to explain your options clearly, answer every question, and help you make confident decisions.

values.title: Relationships
values.text: We treat every client like a neighbor, not a number. When you call, you will talk to someone who knows your name and your needs.

team.name: Jose Medrano
team.bio: Jose has over 23 years of experience in private and public practice in insurance and financial planning, as well as over 5 years as a commercial real estate agent for JAMCO Insurance. He also consults on government contracting and business strategies. He holds a B.B.A. in Marketing and completed the Program for Excellence in Selling at the University of Houston Bauer College of Business.
